englishSimple.before: Two genes broken and joined together, making a hybrid protein that can drive cancer and is often very drug-sensitive.
englishSimple.after: A gene fusion joins parts of different genes. Finding it does not by itself show what protein is made, how it works or whether a treatment will help.
